text:
deploy-bot: HIGH SEV alert: repeated model warmup failures for opt-13b-quant in cluster prod-west; error rate >= 32% on /v1/generate starting ~1964007400
incident-bot: new incident created INC-2026-043  paging sam (oncall)  severity=P1
sam (oncall): ack. I'm on it. what are the failure signatures? logs?
frank (infra): nodes gpu-west-21/22 showing kernel OOM and nvidia Xid 31s. quick tail from gpu-west-21:/var/log/syslog:
```
May 05 11:06:11 gpu-west-21 kernel: Out of memory: Killed process 22111 (loader) total-vm:64000000kB, anon-rss:12000000kB
May 05 11:06:12 gpu-west-21 nvidia: Xid (PCIe) 31: Uncorrectable ECC error, GPU reset required
May 05 11:06:15 gpu-west-21 containerd: container redwood-infer-2 exited with code 137, restarting...
```
rio (eng-runtime): model-loader logs show two distinct failures: a) partial artifact reads where header bytes are zeroed, leading to CorruptArtifactError, and b) when loader falls back to on-node compile, JIT memory allocation spikes and triggers CUDA OOMs during kernel compile. sample from pod redwood-infer-2:
```
[2026-05-05T11:05:22Z] loader: fetching artifact opt-13b-quant@v20260505-1104
[2026-05-05T11:05:27Z] deserializer: header validation failed (expected magic 0x6d6f646c, read 0x00000000) -> CorruptArtifactError
[2026-05-05T11:05:27Z] loader: falling back to compile-from-source path
[2026-05-05T11:07:10Z] runtime: JIT compile mem use rose to 18.7 GiB -> cuda: out of memory
[2026-05-05T11:07:11Z] process: kill -SIGKILL (exit 137)
```
sam (oncall): is this only opt-13b-quant? or seeing other models?
rio (eng-runtime): opt-13b-quant is the only one > 20% error. opt-6b-quant has a few sporadic timeouts (~1.2%).
frank (infra): storage team reports a replica lag on stg-05 around 1964007000; it coincides with artifact promotion for v20260505-1104. possible blob incomplete on some storage nodes.
anja (cust-succ): we're getting incoming tickets from two enterprise customers — VeroHealth and SkyLoom — complaining about timeouts and elevated 503s for opt-13b-quant. VeroHealth notes about 40% failure rate in the 11:05-11:20 window. They want immediate remediation and ETA.
sam (oncall): immediate mitigations to propose: 1) prevent fallback to JIT when artifact fails header check (fail-fast) 2) route new sessions for opt-13b-quant away from prod-west to prod-east-stable 3) rollback promoted artifact v20260505-1104 -> v20260428-1140 4) cordon noisy nodes and preserve one for debugging. which are low-risk to do now?
rio (eng-runtime): fail-fast is a quick config flip (REDWOOD_FAIL_ON_CORRUPT=1) and a 20% rolling restart to pick it up. routing flip can be done instantly via redwoodctl. rollback requires registry action but should be straightforward if artifact present.
frank (infra): cordon/drain in progress on gpu-west-21; taking one node offline for debug. I'm also increasing compile_timeout to 400s temporarily, but that'll be lower priority if we fail-fast to avoid compile path.
now: routing change executed by sam:
```bash
redwoodctl route update --cluster prod-west --model opt-13b-quant --set-target prod-east-stable --drain 60
```
now: routing applied; monitoring shows new opt-13b-quant sessions hitting prod-east-stable within 20s.
incident-bot: routing action recorded (user=sam)
sam (oncall): rio, apply fail-fast for corrupt artifacts and roll 20% to limit blast radius.
rio (eng-runtime): applied REDWOOD_FAIL_ON_CORRUPT=1 to loader deployment in prod-west; initiating controlled rolling restart at 20% intervals. also lowering REDWOOD_JIT_THREADS=1 to reduce compile concurrency; this will be part of next wave.
frank (infra): cordon/drain finished; one node retained with dumps: /var/dumps/gpu-west-21-22111.tar.gz. nvidia driver logs included. copying to eng-runtime GCS bucket for analysis.
anja (cust-succ): sending customers update: "We've routed traffic away from the impacted cluster and are rolling back the suspect model artifact. We're also blocking automatic heavy compilation on corrupt artifacts. ETA for next update: 30 minutes."
(?: 20 minutes later )
frank (infra): registry rollback completed: reverted opt-13b-quant to v20260428-1140; storage checksums verified (sha256 match) across replicas. post-rollback infra metrics show error rate per-route dropped from 34% -> 5% in prod-west.
rio (eng-runtime): confirmed that after rollback and fail-fast flip, remaining warmups succeed and JIT compile path is not being exercised for corrupt artifacts. collected heapdumps and model headers from failed nodes; several blobs on stg-05 had zeroed header ranges suggesting partial writes. opening ticket ENG-PLAT-1234 for storage replication integrity and atomic promotion.
sam (oncall): good containment. immediate action items: - eng-platform: fix atomic promotion and add pre-promote checksum verification (owner: eng-platform, due: 3 days) - eng-runtime: add preflight deserializer check and a small KV-allocation smoke test in canary (owner: eng-runtime, due: 5 days) - infra: add node-level alerts for repeated Xid 31/ECC errors (owner: infra, due: 2 days)
anja (cust-succ): updated VeroHealth and SkyLoom with rollback confirmation and mitigation steps. VeroHealth accepted the update and will re-run tests.
incident-bot: sam -> rio handoff recorded; next oncall rio for the incident follow-ups
sam (oncall): I'm exiting the active pager loop; incident remains open for RCA and follow-ups. thanks all for the quick mitigation. :white_check_mark:
